camera.why: The camera scans barcodes and takes photos.
camera.blocked: Camera access is off. Turn it on in Settings to scan and take photos.

location.why: Your location finds nearby stores and devices.
location.blocked: Location access is off. Turn it on in Settings to find nearby stores and devices.

photos.why: Photo access lets you pick and save pictures.
photos.blocked: Photo access is off. Turn it on in Settings to pick and save pictures.

bluetooth.why: Bluetooth connects printers, scales, cash drawers and card readers.
bluetooth.blocked: Bluetooth access is off. Turn it on in Settings to connect your devices.

microphone.why: The microphone records voice notes and video sound.
microphone.blocked: Microphone access is off. Turn it on in Settings to record sound.
